QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_17

question.text: Management Fees for an AIF begin to accrue from which date?

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.1: Management Fees accrue from the date of the First Close, up to the date when the AIF is dissolved. The Trap: Option A is pre-fund. Option C is late — the period between First and Final Close would go unfeed. Option D is the WRONG trigger. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B tests this accrual start; XIX-C requires the manager to track equalisation interest for late-close investors. Manager's Pro-Tip: Late-close investors must pay 'equalisation interest' so early-close LPs are made whole. Document the equalisation rate (often 8% or hurdle rate) in the PPM subscription terms — this is a frequent source of LP disputes.
